rules: Every source-declared attachment must produce exactly one attachment record.
Missing attachment bytes must never be silently ignored.
If bytes exist, sha256 must be computed over exact bytes.
If bytes do not exist, content_sha256_or_unknown must remain UNKNOWN.
Attachment order within the source message must be preserved.
Attachment metadata must not be invented.
hundred_percent_binding: 100% full-context claim is BLOCKED when any source-declared attachment remains MISSING_FROM_EXPORT or UNRESOLVED.
